newsitem.title: USA: Apartment Investment to buy three new properties.
newsitem.headline: Apartment Investment to buy three new properties.

text.p: Apartment Investment and Management Co said Tuesday that it has agreed to acquire three multifamily apartment properties totaling 536 apartment units located in Tustin, Calif., and Orlando, Fla., in two separate transactions.

The acquisition price for the three properties totals $28.8 million, which includes $1.7 million which it has budgeted for initial capital expenditures. The combined stabilized annual contribution to the company's cash earned for shareholders, the company's measure of profitability, is expected to be between $0.01 and $0.02 per share.
The company expects to close on all the properties by April 30.
Apartment Investment is a real estate investment trust primiarily involved in aprtment properties which serve the middle market.
